name: Pumble
description: Team collaboration and messaging app featuring channels, direct messages, files, and workspace management.

evidence.claim: Pumble API addon allows generating API keys for HTTP requests supporting sending messages, reactions, etc.
Pumble provides a REST integration API with OpenAPI docs and a Node SDK.

notes: Pumble offers both a simpler API addon (API keys) and a more advanced integration API requiring app tokens and user/bot tokens. A Node SDK is available for integration.
